scientific_intent.scientific_operator: Independent square matrix-vector products using GEMM with n=1, alpha=1, beta=0, and padded leading dimensions
scientific_intent.numerical_method: Vendor H/S/DgemmBatched, no authored device algorithm
scientific_intent.community_use: A reproducible batched linear-operator primitive for many independent small systems; it does not validate a particular physical model or trained network
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Every active result checked by independent dot products under typed rounding bounds; all padding/guards and actual inputs/pointer lists exact
limitations: Vendor accumulation precision/algorithm selection not inferred from storage/API type
Framework allocation plus NVIDIA vendor-library interoperability, not portable authored kernels
